about_the_game:
Locals from the nearby village have gone mad with a new discovery. Their eyes filled blue flame, some being physically altered, gaining unseen strength. The enchanting blue flames burn hotter than anything ever previously known. Fight your way through to the source of what is causing all the chaos around you.

Or will you succumb to the blue flames yourself?

Fast-Paced, Snappy Combat

Hone Your Reflexes to Overcome Your Enemies.

Unrelenting Bosses

Vicious Foes Stand in Your Way, You Must Push Through and Learn how to Overcome Their Strength.

Expansive World

Uncover the Secrets of this Mysterious and Dark World.

content_descriptors.notes: Cerulean Singe contains stylized blood and enemy designs showing gore.
